summary: Wang expects very powerful AI soon and wants it widely shared, and now stresses alignment and oversight after once ranking leadership above safety.

statements.quote: Racing on recursive self-improvement is one of the riskiest pathways for potential loss of control to powerful models.
We do believe alignment can be the gating factor for scaling as we get closer to the frontier.
Looking back in a decade, it’ll be obvious that intelligence became abundant and that agency became abundant.
when we empower more and more small businesses, more creators with AI tools and AI products and AI platforms, the opportunity vastly outstrips any of the disruption.
Safety is not the number one goal. Leadership is the number one goal.
